value.d: Every reference PDF is exported by Microsoft Word and SHA-pinned. Redlines are opened in Word too: if Word refuses the file, the tool scores 0 for that pair.
Failures are not dropped. A crash, a timeout or an unopenable file counts as 0 in ITT mean and median, so a tool cannot improve its rank by skipping hard documents.
Ranks tie (n=) when the paired bootstrap interval of the median difference to the row above includes 0. 2,000 resamples, seed 42.

From 0.17.0 the tables on this page are the bench's fixed evaluation sets (set version 2026-11-03.1), the same documents for every release; every row's inputs are sha256-listed in the engine's release_info/. The comparators are the vendor refresh's runs on the same sets, newest version per tool — a tool the refresh did not run shows as not run, never 0. Full-corpus runs remain in the bench's RESULTS.md.
